title: An Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-term Safety and Efficacy of BMN 351 in Participants with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
official: An Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-term Safety and Efficacy of Weekly Intravenous Infusions of BMN 351 in Participants with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Amenable to Exon 51 Skipping
summary: Main objective: To assess the long-term safety and tolerability of BMN 351 in participants with DMD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants must have completed 351-201 or 351-203 studies without permanent discontinuation of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or withdrawal from the study
2. Currently receiving treatment with oral corticosteroids, on a stable dose regimen during 351-201, and must remain on a consistent dose regimen throughout 351-202 or 351-203 except for modifications to accommodate changes in weight
3. Willing to use contraception (sexually mature males) throughout the study and for 90 days after the final dose, if sexually active
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have known coagulation disorder
